name: Breadcrumb Intent
summary: UX vocabulary for a location trail: an ordered path from a root section to the current page, where earlier items are links back up and the last item is the current page. Refines the hierarchical structure of the Navigation intent; the current-item marker is derived from it.

current.description: How the last item is presented. It is always the current page: marked aria-current="page" (derived from Navigation hierarchical structure) and never a link

separator.description: How items are divided. A visual divider only; hidden from assistive technology so the trail reads as an ordered list

overflow.description: What happens when the trail is wider than its container

description:
The Breadcrumb Intent describes where the user is within a hierarchy. It composes the Navigation intent (structure: hierarchical) and adds only the trail presentation.

Landmark

The trail sits in a nav landmark with an accessible name, and the items form an ordered list.

Current Item

The last item is the current page: aria-current="page", not a link. Every earlier item is a link.

Separator

  • glyph: a divider character, hidden from assistive technology.
  • none: no divider.

Overflow

  • truncate: long labels are cut with an ellipsis; the trail stays on one line.
  • wrap: the trail wraps onto further lines.
